title: Consent to one earlier diplomatic message
description: Independent commanders use authenticated development-provider commands. The creator shares one of two earlier messages; the recipient reviews and accepts its scope, then reloads. An uninvolved commander never receives the room or either message. Admission uses the labelled emulator clock and actual scheduler endpoint, not injected state. Managed-key and fault journeys remain separate coverage.
